newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-APEC to announce food standards deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-APEC to announce food standards deal - paper.

text.p: The Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation (APEC) forum is expected next week to announce an agreement on mutual recognition of food standards, The Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Thursday.
The newspaper said the APEC agreement would mean a food product tested and certified in Australia would be automatically recognised in other participating countries.
"At present, food exporters suffer from costs and delays imposed by the duplication of such procedures -- a major non-tariff barrier to regional trade," the newspaper said.

It said the announcement would be made next week in the Philippines during the lead-up to the annual summit of APEC leaders from November 22. The agreement would cover labelling, export inspection, verification and certification of standards.
